figurative_meaning_en: To make one's existence or presence apparent
example_sentences_in_bangla: পার্টিতে প্রবেশ করে সে জানান দিল তার উপস্থিতি দিয়ে।
ক্লাসে না এসে সে জানান দেয়নি কোনো কারণ।
example_sentences_in_english: Upon entering the party, he made his presence known with a loud greeting.
He didn't make his absence known by providing any reason for the class.
note: This idiom is commonly used in informal Bengali speech to indicate subtly revealing one's presence or intentions.
